### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>sigstore/fulcio (github.com/sigstore/fulcio)</summary>

### [`v1.9.0`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v190)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.8.8...v1.9.0)

This release bumps the minimum Go version to 1.27, in order to support ML-DSA in a future release.
Prebuilt containers now use the latest Distroless image based on Debian 13.

#### Features

- Specify the environment the identity provider is supported ([#​2410](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2410))
- Serve TLS on HTTP/duplex and make TLS policy configurable ([#​2418](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2418))

#### Fixes / Refactors

- Format large whole-number claims without scientific notation ([#​2406](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2406))
- Replace archived go-grpc-prometheus with go-grpc-middleware provider ([#​2428](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2428))

</details>
